name: PowerShell Command Execution
description: Use of obfuscated PowerShell to execute an arbitrary command; outputs "Hello, from PowerShell!". Example is from the 2021 Threat Detection Report by Red Canary.

obfuscated_code.description: Defaults to: Invoke-Expression with a "Write-Host" line.

mapping_evidence.note: Rule(s) 92057 were pre-assigned without validation against a real event; moved to candidate_rule_ids until verified with wazuh-logtest and a real execution.

Windows gap found in Phase 3: original execution MISSED under healthy Sysmon telemetry (only generic stock 92032/92052 fired, which also fire on benign cmd.exe /C children). JISRSEC rule(s) deployed 2026-11-03 20:06 UTC. Offline wazuh-logtest replay cannot emulate eventchannel decoding, so validation is LIVE: retest DETECTED and benign negative controls JISRSEC-CTRL-WIN-001/002 TN (e5d04bd6, 4552027a, re-run after the engine fix 44cdf5cd, d6fc4ce9). Stock 92057 (L12) evaluated and NOT suitable for this test: it requires parentImage powershell.exe, but the test runs powershell.exe -e from cmd.exe (verified on the real Sysmon event), so 92057 cannot fire. 100209 covers encoded PowerShell from non-PowerShell parents; 92057 keeps covering the PowerShell-parent case.

alerts.description: PowerShell executed a base64-encoded command (parent C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe)
